name: stynar
description: Find B2B prospects, write and launch cold email campaigns from your own mailbox, and handle replies — using your Stynar account.

interface.longDescription: Stynar runs cold email outreach from your own mailboxes. Connect your Stynar account to search a licensed B2B people database, reveal verified work emails, write and launch campaigns, follow results, and read and answer replies — all from the conversation. Every action that spends credits or sends email is confirmed with you first. Requires a Stynar account.
defaultPrompt: Use Stynar to show how my campaigns did this month.
Use Stynar to find heads of marketing at SaaS companies in Bengaluru.
Use Stynar to go through my latest replies and draft answers.
